scope: Private pilot: 3 instances x 3 capacities x 3 independent trials per solver
timing: FEM: A100 process wall with cached incidence-derived directions, excluding historical calibration and direction construction; KaHyPar: best local CPU, cold serial CLI restarts. Hardware differs and no cold full-pipeline speedup is claimed.
cut: Feasible original unweighted cut-net, integer capacity floor((1+epsilon)*ceil(n/2))
caution: Three trials cannot establish 97%/99% reliability; every projection is a plug-in estimate with Wilson uncertainty. No-hit trials are censored, never converted to finite observed TTT.
reference_policy: Fixed using only earlier FEM calibration batch 0 and earlier audited KaHyPar-K seed 0; no evaluation cuts used; best known within these two calibration policies, not proved optimum
